title: Seller Performance Standing: Recent-Listing Hold on Points Retired at Closing
content:
**Hold.** The recent-listing hold is the recent hold of 2 points when a listing policy or restricted product violation was recorded in the last six whole calendar months, the year hold of 1 point when one was recorded in the last twelve whole calendar months but none in the last six, and nothing otherwise.

When a seller closes the selling account under Seller Performance Standing, the hold is subtracted from the retired points after they have been rounded down to a whole point; the result never falls below zero, and the retirement cap then limits it. For closure, whole calendar months are counted by calendar date back from the closing date: a violation lies in the last N whole calendar months when fewer than N whole months have passed from its recording date to the closing date.

## Schedule

| Most recent listing policy or restricted product violation | Hold |
|---|---|
| in the last six whole calendar months | 2 points |
| in the last twelve but not the last six | 1 point |
| none in the last twelve whole calendar months | nothing |

Serious violations do not enter this hold.

## Boundary (hypothetical closing date 10 November)

| Most recent listing-type violation recorded on | Whole months passed | Hold |
|---|---|---|
| 11 May | 5 | 2 points |
| 10 May | 6 | 1 point |
| 11 November of the previous year | 11 | 1 point |
| 10 November of the previous year | 12 | nothing |

**Worked figure.** Rounded-down retired points of 3 less a hold of 2 leave 1; rounded-down retired points of 1 less a hold of 2 leave zero, not a negative number.
